VAR SelectedDate =
    MAX( 'Calendar'[Date] )

VAR MostActiveStoreLogic =
    CALCULATE(
        VAR TopStoreId =
            MAXX(
                TOPN(
                    1,
                    SUMMARIZE(
                        employees,
                        employees[Store_Id],
                        "Active Employees", [Total Active Employee]
                    ),
                    [Active Employees], DESC
                ),
                employees[Store_Id]
            )
        VAR TopStoreName =
            LOOKUPVALUE(
                stores[Store_Name],
                stores[Store_Id],
                TopStoreId
            )
        VAR ActiveEmployeesCount =
            CALCULATE(
                [Total Active Employee],
                employees[Store_Id] = TopStoreId
            )
        RETURN
            "Most : " & TopStoreName & " : " & ActiveEmployeesCount,
        FILTER(
            ALL(employees),
            employees[Hire_Date] <= SelectedDate
        )
    )

RETURN
    MostActiveStoreLogic
